dvids.title: U.S. Forces End Operation Inherent Resolve Mission in Iraq
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) completed the orderly departure of U.S. forces and equipment from Erbil Air Base, Sept. 30, marking the end of the Operation Inherent Resolve mission in Iraq.
